title: GitHub 负责人开始质疑 Pull Request：半年内 Agent 起草的 PR 占比从 17% 飙到 40%
summary: GitHub CEO Jay Parikh 公开表示 PR 不该成为所有项目的必经流程——数据显示半年内由 Coding Agent 起草首版的 PR 已占平台 40%，协作范式正被真实改写。
summary_en: GitHub CEO Jay Parikh publicly questioned whether pull requests should be mandatory for every project, arguing that changing collaboration practices may warrant exceptions. GitHub data indicates that within six months, pull requests whose initial versions were drafted by coding agents rose from 17% to 40% of the platform’s total, suggesting that automated drafting is already materially reshaping how developers collaborate, although the note does not provide further methodological detail.
body:
GitHub CEO Jay Parikh 公开表示 PR 不该成为所有项目的必经流程——数据显示半年内由 Coding Agent 起草首版的 PR 已占平台 40%，协作范式正被真实改写。
